issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 04 asks for the sums of female and male inhabitants grouped by Regierungsbezirk (the name of the respective Regierungsbezirk). The solution groups the results by 'kreis' (Landkreis) instead (GROUP BY kreis). This contradicts the task requirement and would confuse students: grouping by kreis produces aggregates per Landkreis rather than per Regierungsbezirk and is inconsistent with the problem description and expected grouping column.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the GROUP BY clause in the solution to group by regierungsbezirk (GROUP BY regierungsbezirk) so the query matches the task description. Example correction: SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk
